killedBy: the screen capture adapter refuses a capability that disagrees with the state it names (issue #844)
why: Accepts a recipe whose capability contradicts the state it names. A `headless-touch` recipe pointed at a desktop state then captures the DESKTOP pane and files it as touch evidence -- and it looks like a perfectly good Settings screenshot, because the only difference is that control-relevance.ts omits `touchScheme` and `fireMode` without a touchscreen. The touch flag lives on the state so the layout sweep honours it too, which is exactly what lets the two disagree.
